messages:
anya (PM): quick sync — we need to pick which models to prioritize for Q4 onboarding. suggestions: Mistral-instruct-7B, Falcon-40B-instruct, and Llama3-70B. thinking RICE + sequencing by customer demand + runtime friction.

sam (ML Eng): +1. can we use a lightweight RICE table to make it objective?

jordan (Solutions): acme and several startups asked specifically for Llama3-70B for long-context docs. big enterprise ask.

maya (Catalog): from usage analytics: most self-serve traffic skews toward smaller instruct models (cost-sensitive). Mistral shows up in requests a lot.

lee (Runtime): engineering note — Falcon variants mostly work on our current kernels. Llama3-70B needs additional kernel paths and large-kv memory tuning; higher effort.

anya (PM): appended a quick RICE sketch (very rough):
```
Model                 Reach  Impact  Confidence  Effort  RICE
mistral-instruct-7b   1200   3.5     0.7         3       980
falcon-40b-instruct   800    3.8     0.75        4       600
llama3-70b            300    5       0.5         9       83
```

sam (ML Eng): nice — numbers look plausible. note: "Reach"=monthly potential customers, "Effort"=platform eng-weeks scaled. confidence is fuzzy.

jordan (Solutions): RICE suggests Mistral first, then Falcon. but Llama3 is high impact for enterprise revenue. maybe parallelize work with Dedicated customers?

lee (Runtime): parallelization ok but cost of adding Llama3 path is non-trivial — ~8–12 eng-weeks + perf regressions to iron out. we could do a trimmed rollout: quantized variant first? that still needs quant kernels.

maya (Catalog): two sequencing options: (A) low-effort-high-reach first (Mistral -> Falcon), (B) customer-driven enterprise path (Llama3 prioritized for Dedicated). both valid.

anya (PM): proposal: do (A) for hosted catalog in Q4, while carving a focused Dedicated onboarding project for Llama3 with an SLA-driven timeline. criteria to mark a model onboarded:
- perf vs baseline (p50 latency within threshold)
- cost per token within projected budget
- model tests: hallucination evals pass baseline set
- canary usage with 3 customers for 2 weeks w/o major issues

jordan (Solutions): add: docs + sample prompts and best-practice quantization notes before GA. customers hate surprises. :point_up:

sam (ML Eng): can we add automated evals to block rollout? e.g., run eval harness nightly and fail if regression > X%.

lee (Runtime): yes — we have CI hooks. will add a perf/regression gate for any onboarding PR.

anya (PM): timeline idea:
- Week 1–2: spec + quick PoC for Mistral
- Week 3–6: runtime integration + quant tests
- Week 7: internal QA + customer canary start
- Week 8–9: iterate on feedback -> GA

maya (Catalog): I'll prep catalog metadata and tagging for routing/policy (cost-tier, latency-tier, enterprise-flag).

jordan (Solutions): i'll line up 2 beta customers for Mistral canary. Acme wants Llama3 but OK to join Dedicated track.

anya (PM): decision: move Mistral first (hosted), Falcon behind it, Llama3 on a Dedicated/enterprise track. owners: sam+lee for runtime, maya for catalog, jordan for customers. I'll create a ticket with RICE numbers and acceptance criteria.

deploy-bot: scheduled: onboarding-ticket created by anya — #12345

sam (ML Eng): 👍 will start a spike tomorrow.

lee (Runtime): noted. adding kernel tasks to sprint board.

maya (Catalog): will draft catalog entry and sample prompts.

anya (PM): thanks all — let's re-check RICE numbers after PoC (confidence should update). follow-ups in the ticket. :sparkles:
